t: What Does The Name Heimi Mean?
s: Most prominently, it is a short form of the Germanic names Heimrich or Heinrich (cognate with Henry), built on the elements heim “home, household” and rīhhi “ruler, power,” yielding the meaning “ruler of the home” or “lord of the household.” In Old Norse and Icelandic contexts, Heimi can be read as a nickname derived from heima “home; at home,” and it also echoes the Old High German personal name Haimo/Heimo (“home-man”), which survives in modern German as Heimo.
